description: A tall, gaunt man in a dark quilted dressing gown stands at a cluttered wooden table of glass flasks, retorts and test tubes, holding a test tube over a candle flame. Behind him a seated man in a waistcoat sits by a fireplace in a dim, wallpapered room with papers pinned to the wall and a pipe on the mantel. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with warm candlelight and no visible lettering or frame.
